name: Lisa Glover
occupation: Platte County treasurer-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Lisa Glover is the Platte County treasurer-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Kristi Rietz, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election results list her as the winner of the treasurer race.
